# DinoCraft

A prehistoric voxel sandbox for **Windows** and **Mac**: survival and creative worlds, dinosaurs, crafting, texture and shader packs, cosmetics and a skin creator, and multiplayer between Mac and Windows.

## Download

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Windows** (10 or 11, 64-bit) | [**Download for Windows**](https://github.com/oneemailgotbannedndone-ai/DinoCraft-Releases/releases/latest/download/DinoCraft-Windows.zip) |
| **Mac** (Apple Silicon, macOS 14 or later) | [**Download for Mac**](https://github.com/oneemailgotbannedndone-ai/DinoCraft-Releases/releases/latest/download/DinoCraft-Mac.zip) |

These links always give you the newest version. Older versions are on the [releases page](https://github.com/oneemailgotbannedndone-ai/DinoCraft-Releases/releases).

## Install

**Windows**
1. Open your **Downloads** folder and right-click **DinoCraft-Windows.zip**.
2. Choose **Extract All…** and click **Extract**.
3. In the new folder, double-click **DinoCraft Launcher.exe** (or **DinoCraft.exe** to go straight to the game). If Windows shows "Windows protected your PC", click **More info** → **Run anyway**.

**Mac**
1. Double-click **DinoCraft-Mac.zip** in **Downloads**; it unzips to **DinoCraft.app** and **DinoCraft Launcher.app**.
2. Drag **both** into **Applications** (keep them together: the launcher starts the game next to it).
3. Open it. The first time, macOS may say it can't check the app: open **System Settings** → **Privacy & Security**, scroll down and click **Open Anyway** (on older macOS, right-click the app and choose **Open**).

## Updating

You only download once. When a new version comes out, the launcher shows **Update to Build N**: click it, then **Restart to Update**. Your worlds, skins and settings are kept.
